author: Aditya Kumar
text: Drop to Print is a very useful app for students and professionals. It saves a lot of time because you don't need to stand at a print shop waiting. You can simply upload your PDF from home, and once it's printed, you get a notification to collect it. Highly recommended!

author: Sneha Tripathi
text: Very useful and easy-to-use app. Uploading documents and getting prints is quick and hassle-free. The interface is simple, and it saves a lot of time. Great app for students and anyone who needs fast printing services.

author: Shivam Singh
text: This is a fantastic printing app! It supports easy PDF and photo printing, and the quick print feature saves a lot of time. Everything works smoothly — highly recommended!

author: Vanshika Tyagi
text: This app is very user-friendly. It's a useful app for anyone who needs mobile printing on a regular basis.

author: Harsh Tiwari
text: It's really a useful app. It reduces too much effort and time.

author: Palak Aggarwal
text: Amazing app and easy to use.

author: Maya Shankar Singh
text: It's beneficial for all the students who are pursuing any degree.

author: Kushagra Rai
text: Great app, hope it is adopted by every shop.

author: Aditya Pandey
text: Best experience using this app. It saves time.

author: Ramleela Darshan
text: Best time saver app for print.

author: PiNotes
text: Everything is good and the app is awesome. Would love image printing and support for larger PDF files too — hope those get added soon.

author: Himanshu Raj
text: Overall a nice experience. Looking forward to camera and gallery printing support.
